title: Couplet
summary: COUPLET, noun 1. Two verses; a pair of rhymes. 2. A division of a hymn or ode in which an equal number or equal measure of verse is found in each part, called a strophe. 3. A pair; as a couplet of dov

inlines.v: COUPLET, noun 1. Two verses; a pair of rhymes. 2. A division of a hymn or ode in which an equal number or equal measure of verse is found in each part, called a strophe. 3. A pair; as a couplet of doves. [Not used.]
